latvia.title: Un inel încrustat cu 321 de diamante, primit cadou, începe să ridice întrebări despre decizia lui Trump privind taxe vamale de 0% aplicată unei țări UE
latvia.description: Doi senatori americani, ambii democrați, solicită explicații de la două firme belgiene cu privire la un inel din aur de 18 carate, încrustat cu 321 de diamante, care i-a fost oferit președintelui SUA, Donald Trump, cu câteva săptămâni înainte ca Statele Unite să scutească industria europeană a diamantelor de noile taxe vamale, scrie marți Reuters. …

latvia.title: 10th Baltic Film Days bring the best of new Latvian and Lithuanian cinema
latvia.description: The Baltic Film Days will take place from August 25–26, bringing recent major Latvian and Lithuanian films to the screen at Tallinn's Sõprus Cinema.

latvia.title: USA palus Ukrainal lõpetada rünnakud Venemaa sadamaid kasutavatele tankeritele
latvia.description: USA asepresident J. D. Vance palus Ukraina presidendil Volodõmõr Zelenskõil lõpetada rünnakud tankeritele ja taristule, mida kasutatakse Kasahstani nafta eksportimiseks Venemaal asuva Novorossiiski sadama kaudu. USA hinnangul on Ukraina rünnakud üks põhjustest, mis kergitavad nafta hinda.

latvia.title: Panathinaikose omanik ei varja: unistan Jokici palkamisest
latvia.description: Korvpalliportaali BasketNews andmetel tegi Ateena Panathinaikos ametliku katse tuua oma ridadesse NBA ühe suurima tähe Nikola Jokici, kuid pakkumine lükati tagasi. Hiljem kinnitas seda ka serblase kauaaegne agent Miško Ražnatovic.

latvia.title: Exports value up in June in Latvia
latvia.description: Central Statistical Bureau (CSB) provisional data published on August 11 show that in June 2026 Latvia had foreign trade turnover of EUR 3.87 billion, and at current prices it was 16 % higher than a year ago.

latvia.title: Too many kabači? Peel 'em, pickle 'em, stick 'em in the freezer
latvia.description: Have you planted too many kabači (courgettes) again? Fear not – you don't have to eat all of them at once. You can either pass this problem on to your neighbours – or preserve the veggies for winter.

latvia.title: Latvia joins diplomatic ballistic missile pledge
latvia.description: On 11th August, Latvia and several other countries joined a joint statement initiated by the United States of America (USA) on ballistic missile launch notifications, in which countries are encouraged to participate in mechanisms such as the Hague Code of Conduct against Ballistic Missile Proliferation, which provides for advance notification of ballistic missile launches.

latvia.title: 'Discount' on timely paid fines proposed in Latvia
latvia.description: To encourage timely payment of administrative fines, the Ministry of Justice is proposing changes where in certain cases, the fine would be reduced if paid on time, the Ministry announced on August 11.

latvia.title: Discover "Rīga's Sweetest Secret" this week
latvia.description: During the celebrations for Riga’s 825th birthday, from 3 to 16 August, the city invites you to go on a sweet stroll and discover one of Latvia’s most iconic desserts – the “Vecrīga” or Old Rīga cake.

latvia.title: Jēkabpils doctor attacked while on duty
latvia.description: A doctor at Jēkabpils Regional Hospital has been attacked by an aggressive visitor who had accompanied a patient. The doctor has suffered a concussion and stresses that he no longer feels safe at his workplace, Vidusdaugava Television reported on August 12.

latvia.title: Potato yields expected to be better than last year in Latvia
latvia.description: Potato harvest this year is likely to be better than last year, and potato prices are lower – good news for buyers, not so good for sellers, Latvian Radio reported on August 12.

latvia.title: Late traffic closure announcement causes chaos in central Rīga
latvia.description: Drivers in Rīga found themselves spending longer than usual on the road on Tuesday. Traffic arrangements had been changed in the Old Town area, but residents were not informed of this in good time. The local council acknowledges that a communication error occurred, Latvian Television reported on August 11.

latvia.title: airBaltic situation is 'very serious' warns Latvian government
latvia.description: The Latvian government provided a partial update on the situation with regard to the financial prospects of national airline airBaltic on August 11th, describing the situation as "very serious".

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 11th August, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Measles booster for children in Latvia will be earlier
latvia.description: Under amendments to the childhood vaccination schedule introduced by the government, the second dose of the combined measles, mumps and rubella vaccine is now to be administered at the age of four, rather than seven, LETA reports.

latvia.title: Training under way for Latvia's next basketball challenges
latvia.description: On Monday, August 10th the 15-player Latvian men's basketball squad officially began preparations for the second round of World Cup qualifying matches against Croatia and Israel scheduled for the end of the month.

latvia.title: Where to watch the solar eclipse in Latvia?
latvia.description: Ahead of the upcoming partial solar eclipse on Wednesday, 12 August (starting at around 20:06 in the evening and reaching its maximum at 20:57) it is worth remembering that looking directly at the Sun is unsafe; the best place to look at it this time will be the beach, LSM.lv reports.

latvia.title: How many Latvians are there in Estonia?
latvia.description: Here's a good quiz question: according to the latest official figures, how many Latvians are there living in Estonia?

latvia.title: 31,000 Ukrainians currently have refuge in Latvia
latvia.description: On 30 June 2026, a total of 4.41 million non-EU citizens who fled Ukraine had temporary protection status in the EU, according to Eurostat figures published on August 11th.

latvia.title: Latvian mountaineers' bodies repatriated
latvia.description: The repatriation of the three mountaineers who died in Alaska from the US to Latvia has been completed, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (MFA) told the LETA news agency.

latvia.title: Annual inflation in Latvia at 2.6% in July
latvia.description: The data of the Central Statistical Bureau (CSB), published on August 11, show that, compared to July 2025, in July 2026 the average level of consumer prices increased by 2.6 %.

latvia.title: Latvia launches 'Operation Werewolf' to curb illegal migration
latvia.description: Operation “Vilkatis” (Werewolf), aimed at tackling illegal migration, was launched in Latvia on 11 August, Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs (United List) announced on Tuesday. The operation is scheduled to run until the end of August.

latvia.title: First illegal border tunnel found at Silene, Latvia
latvia.description: In Latvia, in the parish of Skrudaliena in the Augšdaugava municipality, the first underground tunnel through which 15 migrants had illegally entered the country from Belarus was discovered on Monday, 10 August. They have been returned to Belarus, according to the State Border Guard (VRS).

latvia.title: ArtificiaI Intelligence event 'AI Connect' to take place in Rīga
latvia.description: On 22 August 2026, an event called 'AI Connect 2026' will take place at the RTU Science and Innovation Centre in Rīga, reports Labs of Latvia.

latvia.title: Railway arsonists plead guilty in Latvia
latvia.description: Three of the four individuals have pleaded guilty to arson of railway facilities and to aiding a foreign state in activities directed against Latvia, Latvian Television reported on August 11. The case continued to be heard at Riga City Court on Monday.

latvia.title: Rīga's birthday celebrations will see traffic restrictions
latvia.description: Extensive traffic restrictions are expected in the city during Rīga’s birthday celebrations. Vehicle traffic will be closed on 11 November Embankment and in Old Riga, with stopping and parking bans in place, as well as restrictions on the movement of micro-mobility devices and watercraft.

latvia.title: Text of Dombrava's 'Spanish letter' released
latvia.description: The text of a letter from Latvian Interior Minister Jānis Dombrava (National Alliance) to his Spanish counterpart Fernando Grande-Marlaska – which reportedly was not well received in Madrid – has been published.

latvia.title: Baby zebra born at Rīga Zoo
latvia.description: At the Rīga National Zoo, Greta, a female Grevy’s zebra, gave birth to a baby girl named Mia at the end of June. This is the first time that a Grevy’s zebra has given birth at the Riga Zoo.

latvia.title: Corruption cops look at United List politicians posing on combine harvester
latvia.description: The Corruption Prevention and Combating Bureau (KNAB) will launch an investigation into whether the activities last Friday of representatives of the United List (AS) party alliance, including Prime Minister Andris Kulbergs, complied with the requirements of the Pre-election Campaign Law, the bureau told the LETA news agency.

latvia.title: Latgale has no 24-hour pharmacies left
latvia.description: The last 24-hour pharmacy in Daugavpils has reduced its opening hours – medicines can now be purchased there until 11.00 pm. This means that there are no longer any 24-hour pharmacies in the entire Latgale region, and the nearest one is in Rīga, LSM's Latgale editorial reported on August 11.

latvia.title: Unmanned platform developed for Latvian army needs
latvia.description: On Monday, the high-tech company ‘LV-Teh’ and the University of Latvia signed an agreement on strategic cooperation in the field of research and innovation. This will enable, for example, the development of robotic systems and smart platforms that the company has designed for the Latvian Army, Latvian Television reported.

latvia.title: News in simple Latvian: 10th August, 2026
latvia.description: Every evening at 21:00, Latvian Radio 1 broadcasts a five-minute summary of the day's news stories in a simplified language format called Ziņas vieglajā valodā ('News in simple language').

latvia.title: Rīga StratCom centre publishes new Russia report
latvia.description: The Rīga-based NATO Strategic Communications Centre of Excellence (STRATCOMCOE) has published a new report on Russia's notorious propaganda machine.

latvia.title: One month until 'Latvian Dual-Use Export Forum' on NATO's eastern border
latvia.description: More than 150 participants from 19 countries will be in attendance at the Latvian Dual-Use Export Forum in Rēzekne on 6–7 September, according to organizers of the event.

latvia.title: Latvia has quite a few firefighters
latvia.description: In 2025, there were 372 400 professional firefighters in the EU, representing 0.18% of the total employment in the EU.

latvia.title: 'Atlantis' mural unveiled in Rīga underpass
latvia.description: In an underpass near the Central Station in Rīga, an ambitious street art work called "Riga Atlantis" has been created.

latvia.title: E-address to be unavailable over weekend in Latvia
latvia.description: At the end of this week – from 22:00 on 14 August up to and including 16 August – scheduled technical upgrades will take place on the e-address system, during which time the e-address functionality will be unavailable.

latvia.title: Battery park to be built in Grobiņa, Latvia
latvia.description: The energy infrastructure company SIA ‘Enersense’ is to build a 100-megawatt (MW) capacity, 200-megawatt-hour (MWh) battery energy storage system (BESS) park in Grobiņa parish, the company announced on August 10.

latvia.title: Boat service from Vecmīlgrāvis to Bolderāja coming next spring
latvia.description: It might be possible to travel between the Rīga neighbourhoods Vecmīlgrāvis and Bolderāja by boat starting next spring, Latvian Radio reported on August 10.

latvia.title: F1 car to rattle around Rīga streets for a few days
latvia.description: The Latvian capital's municipal transport company, Rīgas Satiksme (Riga Transport/RS) is to parade a former Formula 1 car around the city streets for a few days as a publicity stunt.

latvia.title: Latvian Security Service detains Russian war supporter
latvia.description: Last week, on 5 August, the State Security Service (VDD) detained a Russian citizen living in Latvia on suspicion of providing funding to the Russian armed forces to enable them to continue hostilities against Ukraine, the VDD said on August 10th.

latvia.title: What will be on the menu at Latvian schools this year?
latvia.description: Latvian food producers and processing companies are concerned that current procurement rules might lead to more imported food being served in Latvia's schools during the next school year, reports Latvian Radio.

latvia.title: More beach volleyball medals for Latvia
latvia.description: Latvian women's beach volleyball pair Tīna Graudiņa and Anastasija Samoilova lost in the final and therefore won silver medals in the professional tour "Elite 16" level tournament in Hamburg on Sunday, August 9th.

latvia.title: Latvian music journalist Klāss Vāvere dies, reportedly on hike in Mexico
latvia.description: Mexican media TV Azteca, citing local authorities, reports that the prominent Latvian music journalist Klāss Vāvere has died whilst hiking in the mountains.

latvia.title: Roadworks on 58 road sections across Latvia
latvia.description: Construction work is continuing on 58 sections of the national road network, Latvian State Roads (LVC) said on August 10.

latvia.title: Windy week ahead in Latvia
latvia.description: Forecasts indicate that the weather in Latvia will become cooler and windier over the next few days.

latvia.title: Foolish Hearts: politicians and Russia spread nonsense about Raimonds Pauls 'ban'
latvia.description: Why on earth did Latvia ban songs by its best-beloved and best-known modern composer and performer, Raimonds Pauls?

latvia.title: Locals rally for fishing ban in Māras Pond, Rīga
latvia.description: Birds cannot speak, but we can be their voice to save their lives. This is the message from Rīga residents who have started collecting signatures to ban fishing in Māras Pond, where abandoned fishing lines and hooks pose a deadly threat to the flock of swans beloved by locals and other waterbirds, Latvian Television reported on August 8.

latvia.title: Teams invited to enter upcoming EUDIS defence hackathon in Latvia
latvia.description: From 15–17 October 2026, the University of Latvia (UL) will host the EUDIS Defence Hackathon 2026 Latvia, an international defence innovation hackathon organised under the European Union Defence Innovation Scheme (EUDIS), at the University’s Academic Centre in Riga, reports Labs of Latvia.

lithuania.description: Egy biztonsági fenyegetés miatt nem az elnöki különgép, az Air Force One fedélzetén távozott Ankarából Donald Trump a júliusi NATO-csúcstalálkozó után, hanem titokban egy másik gépre szállt fel – erről maga az amerikai elnök számolt be helyi idő szerint kedden Ohióban újságírók előtt, megerősítve az esettel kapcsolatos korábbi sajtóinformációt.

lithuania.title: Donald Trump po summite NATO odletel iným lietadlom kvôli možnej bezpečnostnej hrozbe
lithuania.description: Donald Trump po summite NATO neodletel prezidentským špeciálom, ale menším lietadlom kvôli možnej bezpečnostnej hrozbe.

lithuania.title: Trump potvrdil nezvyčajnú operáciu po summite NATO: „Robím to, čo mi povedia“
lithuania.description: Americký prezident Donald Trump v utorok uviedol, že z júlového summitu Severoatlantickej aliancie (NATO) odletel iným lietadlom pre možnú bezpečnostnú hrozbu. Vyjadril sa tak po správach amerických médií, že Trump z Ankary odletel menším lietadlom, a nie na palube prezidentského špeciálu.

lithuania.title: Trump při odletu z Ankary tajně změnil letadlo, píší média. Ukryl se v kontejneru na jídlo
lithuania.description: Americký prezident Donald Trump se při červencovém odletu ze summitu NATO v Ankaře po určitou dobu ukrýval v kontejneru používaném na letištích pro dodávky jídla, aby mohl nepozorovaně opustit palubu prezidentského speciálu Air Force One. Uvádějí to deníky The Washington Post (WP) a The New York Times (NYT), podle něhož pak Trump z Turecka kvůli hrozbám ze strany Íránu neodletěl prezidentským speciálem, ale vojenským letadlem.

lithuania.title: Trump confirmă schimbarea de avioane din Turcia: „Mă ghidez după recomandările Secret Service. Nu am decât să fac ce-mi spun ei”
lithuania.description: Președintele american Donald Trump a confirmat că a schimbat în secret avionul în momentul în care a părăsit summitul NATO din Turcia luna trecută, din cauza unei posibile amenințări, relatează BBC.

lithuania.title: CCR analizează, astăzi, noua Lege ANI. Mandatele aleşilor și declaraţiile de avere ale partenerilor, în centrul contestaţiilor
lithuania.description: Curtea Constituţională a României (CCR) se reuneşte, miercuri, pentru a dezbate sesizările de neconstituţionalitate referitoare la noua Lege a integrităţii. Actul normativ a fost atacat la Curte printr-o sesizare comună a 27 de senatori de la USR şi PNL, dar şi printr-o acţiune separată a preşedintelui Nicuşor Dan.

lithuania.title: „NATO al musulmanilor sunniți”: ce ar putea reprezenta noul pact de apărare Turcia - Arabia Saudită - Pakistan și ce întrebări ridică
lithuania.description: Cel mai recent pact de apărare încheiat între Turcia, Arabia Saudită și Pakistan a fost descris drept un „NATO al musulmanilor sunniți”. Trei dintre cele mai puternice state sunnite din punct de vedere militar s-au reunit pentru a se angaja că un atac armat asupra oricăruia dintre ele va fi considerat un atac asupra celor trei.

lithuania.title: Rusia desfăşoară surprinzător de rapid o reţea de sateliţi asemănătoare Starlink
lithuania.description: Rusia desfăşoară mai rapid decât se credea o versiune proprie a sistemului de internet prin satelit Starlink, a afirmat general-maiorul ucrainean Vadim Skibiţkii, citat marţi de Reuters dintr-un interviu acordat agenţiei RBC-Ucraina.

lithuania.title: Cisiordania se află „la un pas de colaps” din cauza ocupaţiei israeliene, avertizează ONU
lithuania.description: Coordonatorul special adjunct al ONU pentru procesul de pace din Orientul Mijlociu, Ramiz Alakbarov, a avertizat marţi în faţa Consiliului de Securitate că Cisiordania se află „la un pas de colaps” din cauza ocupaţiei ilegale a Israelului, informează EFE, potrivit Agerpres.

lithuania.title: Petrișor Peiu nu este de acord cu amendamentul AUR la Legea ANI: „Mă lupt cu Nicușor Dan, nu cu soția sau ce este doamna... concubină”
lithuania.description: Curtea Constituțională discută miercuri contestațiile pentru Legea integrității, inclusiv cea depusă de președintele Nicușor Dan. Despre amendamentul depus de AUR cu privire la declarațiile de avere extinse și la partenerii de viață ai politicienilor, Petrișor Peiu, liderul senatorilor AUR, a spus la Digi24 că el nu ar fi depus un astfel de amendament, pentru că nu crede că e bine să se lupte cu oameni care nu sunt în politică. „Nu pot să mă bat cu copiii sau nepoții, sau soacra oponentului politic. Trebuie să mă bat cu oponentul politic în soluții pentru țară”, a afirmat senatorul AUR.

lithuania.title: Irineu Darău: Dacă nu poate exista o majoritate de coabitare în Parlament, nu poate exista Guvern
lithuania.description: Ministrul interimar al Economiei, senatorul USR Irineu Darău, consideră că identificarea unei soluții de „coabitare” între partidele pro-europene este esențială pentru asigurarea unei guvernări stabile până în 2028.

lithuania.title: Un avion de vânătoare ucrainean MiG-29 s-a prăbușit în timpul unei misiuni de luptă la Odesa. „Pilotul a încercat să salveze aeronava”
lithuania.description: Un avion de vânătoare ucrainean MiG-29 a luat foc în timpul unei misiuni de luptă în regiunea Odesa, în seara zilei de 10 august, au raportat Forțele Aeriene Ucrainene.

lithuania.title: Amenințarea iraniană și o misiune de diversiune: ce nu s-a spus despre plecarea lui Donald Trump de la summitul NATO de la Ankara
lithuania.description: O amenințare cu asasinarea președintelui Donald Trump, venită din partea Iranului, a determinat desfășurarea unei operațiuni extraordinare luna trecută, în cadrul căreia liderul american a zburat în secret din Turcia cu un alt avion militar, în timp ce Casa Albă a declarat că se afla la bordul Air Force One, a aflat The Washington Post.

lithuania.title: NATO îşi reduce prezenţa în două locuri sensibile din Kosovo
lithuania.description: Misiunea militară a NATO din Kosovo (KFOR) a anunţat luni că îşi reduce prezenţa în două locuri sensibile din Kosovo pentru prima oară de la încheierea războiului dintre separatiştii kosovari şi forţele sârbe la sfârşitul anilor 1990, relatează France Presse.

lithuania.title: O felină mare asemănătoare cu o pumă, semnalată în apropierea Varșoviei. Localnicii, sfătuiți să nu lase copiii nesupravegheați
lithuania.description: Vânători polonezi au observat o felină mare umblând într-o zonă din jurul satului Osiek-Wolka, la circa 75 de kilometri nord de capitala poloneză Varşovia, relatează luni tabloidul Fakt, preluat de agenţia dpa.

lithuania.title: Polonia şi ţările baltice încep să-şi protejeze infrastructura energetică de teama unui atac sub steag fals al Rusiei
lithuania.description: Vecinii nordici ai Rusiei din NATO întăresc măsurile de securitate în jurul barajelor, centralelor electrice şi infrastructurii de gaze naturale, semn al îngrijorării crescânde că Moscova va organiza un atac „sub steag fals” împotriva lor, folosind drone ucrainene, relatează Reuters, citată de News.ro.

lithuania.title: România, locul 4 mondial la Olimpiada Internațională de AI. Lotul român a obținut trei medalii de aur, două de argint și trei de bronz
lithuania.description: România s-a clasat pe locul al patrulea în lume la Olimpiada Internațională de Inteligență Artificială (IOAI), desfășurată în perioada 2-8 august, la Astana, în Kazahstan. Toți cei opt elevi care au reprezentat țara au obținut medalii: trei de aur, două de argint și trei de bronz, într-o competiție la care au participat concurenți din 108 țări și teritorii, potrivit unuia dintre coordonatorii lotului român, Robert Mihai Colca.

lithuania.title: 10.000 de cupluri își pot alege o clinică prin programul FIV. Un embriolog senior explică ce trebuie verificat înainte de a lua decizia
lithuania.description: Pentru cei care își doresc un copil, iar sarcina întârzie să apară, decizia de a începe o procedură de fertilizare in vitro vine, de cele mai multe ori, după luni sau chiar ani de întrebări, investigații, încercări și așteptare. Chiar și după ce au decis să înceapă tratamentul, multe cupluri se confruntă cu o nouă dificultate: costurile procedurii.

lithuania.title: Donald Trump, dezvăluiri despre schimbarea secretă de avioane din Turcia, operațiune trecută sub tăcere de Casa Albă
lithuania.description: Președintele SUA, Donald Trump, a declarat miercuri că, luna trecută, a schimbat în secret avionul în Turcia, la indicația Serviciului Secret al SUA, dar că aeronava cu care a zburat în cele din urmă era totuși mai vulnerabilă decât Air Force One, scrie Reuters. lithuania.description: Curtea Constituțională a României va dezbate, miercuri, sesizările formulate față de legea privind modificarea și completarea unor acte normative în domeniul integrității. lithuania.title: Un inel încrustat cu 321 de diamante, primit cadou, începe să ridice întrebări despre decizia lui Trump privind taxe vamale de 0% aplicată unei țări UE
lithuania.description: Doi senatori americani, ambii democrați, solicită explicații de la două firme belgiene cu privire la un inel din aur de 18 carate, încrustat cu 321 de diamante, care i-a fost oferit președintelui SUA, Donald Trump, cu câteva săptămâni înainte ca Statele Unite să scutească industria europeană a diamantelor de noile taxe vamale, scrie marți Reuters. …

lithuania.title: 10th Baltic Film Days bring the best of new Latvian and Lithuanian cinema
lithuania.description: The Baltic Film Days will take place from August 25–26, bringing recent major Latvian and Lithuanian films to the screen at Tallinn's Sõprus Cinema.

lithuania.description: USA asepresident J. D. Vance palus Ukraina presidendil Volodõmõr Zelenskõil lõpetada rünnakud tankeritele ja taristule, mida kasutatakse Kasahstani nafta eksportimiseks Venemaal asuva Novorossiiski sadama kaudu. lithuania.title: Panathinaikose omanik ei varja: unistan Jokici palkamisest
lithuania.description: Korvpalliportaali BasketNews andmetel tegi Ateena Panathinaikos ametliku katse tuua oma ridadesse NBA ühe suurima tähe Nikola Jokici, kuid pakkumine lükati tagasi. Hiljem kinnitas seda ka serblase kauaaegne agent Miško Ražnatovic.

lithuania.title: Rīga StratCom centre publishes new Russia report
lithuania.description: The Rīga-based NATO Strategic Communications Centre of Excellence (STRATCOMCOE) has published a new report on Russia's notorious propaganda machine.

lithuania.title: One month until 'Latvian Dual-Use Export Forum' on NATO's eastern border
lithuania.description: More than 150 participants from 19 countries will be in attendance at the Latvian Dual-Use Export Forum in Rēzekne on 6–7 September, according to organizers of the event.
